name: duopore-public-focus-session-totals
description: Add up the active time in your work sessions without counting breaks twice.

interface.longDescription: Add up the active time in your work sessions without counting breaks twice. Enter each session's start, end and break length for one day. See total session, break and active minutes. Overlapping sessions are flagged. For adults reviewing their own time. The result measures minutes you entered, not how focused or productive you were.
defaultPrompt: Add up my focus session minutes after taking out breaks.
Check these work sessions for overlaps before totaling them.

positive.prompt: Use Focus Session Totals with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"sessions":[{"id":"S1","date":"2026-10-04","startMinute":540,"endMinute":600,"breakMinutes":10},{"id":"S2","date":"2026-10-04","startMinute":660,"endMinute":690,"breakMinutes":5}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"75 active minutes across 2 non-overlapping sessions.","rows":[{"date":"2026-10-04","sessionCount":2,"elapsedMinutes":90,"breakMinutes":15,"activeMinutes":75}],"warnings":["Sessions crossing midnight must be split into explicit day records. Active minutes exclude entered breaks only; no attention, effort quality or productivity score is inferred."]}
